scope: Paired development treatment: nineteen real material instances, adding two reviewed paper scenes and source-verified white-paper labels under printed hearts. Corrected whole-family grouping matches baseline for all seventeen shared images. No held-out tuning, all-data model or deployment.

groups.reason: Keep all checker weaves together, including source-verified red printed hearts on white cells. Decoration is not independent cut topology. Preserve inherited source and near-duplicate links.

Conservatively group the remaining star, boar, rabbit, bicycle, sloth and protruding-motif photographs. The source-verified ordinary printed checker has moved to checker-family. These inspected development groups are not claimed topology-disjoint from all synthetic recipes.

protocol.encoder: Train decoder at 0.001 and the final three encoder blocks at 0.0001; freeze all earlier parameters and all BatchNorm running statistics.
protocol.comparison: Synthetic-only control plus one mixed real/synthetic run per complete connected source/motif group; identical initial model, draw schedule and updates.
protocol.selection: Fixed final update; no held-out checkpoint selection or tuning.
protocol.metric: Body and globally exchangeable A/B identities, including missing-body joint errors and balanced per-material errors.
protocol.trainingTarget: Undegraded fractional synthetic paper coverage; ignore only two-pixel outer body band for material labels, preserve all body supervision.

followup.reason: Measure corrected printed-paper supervision and two additional checker-scene examples at unchanged compute budget. Real image exposure changes because the labelled pool grows.
followup.commonEvaluation: Score both arms against current corrected nineteen-instance labels, never compare raw baseline metrics on its older known-pixel subset.
